name: Mitsurugi Reiji
source:
Miles Edgeworth began his career as a prosecutor at the young age of 20, and in the four years since has maintained a perfect record of guilty verdicts. Seen as a snob, his condescending nature and relentless prosecution (along with rumors of evidence and witness tampering) have earned him the name "Demon Prosecutor." He despises criminal behavior, and will do anything to get lawbreakers behind bars. And look stylish doing it. 

[spoiler]
Edgeworth left the prosecutor's office to find out what being a prosecutor really meant, coming to the conclusion that prosecutors were seekers of the truth, and that winning a guilty verdict wasn't all that mattered. He later returned and, by the time of the Mask☆DeMasque trials, had become known as the top prosecutor in America. He also traveled abroad to study international law, prosecuting in five other countries. He was also instrumental in finding the leader of a notorious international smuggling ring and bringing him to court.

At some point after Sarushiro's arrest, Edgeworth was promoted to Chief Prosecutor. In October 2020, Edgeworth and his office was dealt a blow when the rookie prosecutor Simon Blackquill was accused and convicted of murder. His confession, combined with Wright's disbarment for using forged evidence a year earlier, helped to spark the so-called "dark age of the law," which despite Edgeworth's efforts, only grew worse as time passed.

Once Wright cleared his name and recruited Athena Cykes to his office, Edgeworth saw his chance. He asked Wright to come back to the world of law in order to help him clear Blackquill's name and end the dark age of the law for good. By pulling enough strings, he was able to allow Wright to pass his bar exam without any problems.
[/spoiler]
